title: Session activity item
description: One entry of the Agents window's Session Activity Bar (`li.action-item.menu-entry > a.action-label.codicon` + `.menu-activity-bar-badge`): a 24px icon-only button that opens or activates a side pane tab, highlighted while its tab is the one the side pane shows, with an optional dot or count badge. With `separator` it renders the bar's group separator instead.
usage: Only inside <vsc-session-activity-bar>. Set `checked` on the entry whose tab the open side pane shows (clicking it again closes the side pane, like the workbench activity bar). `badge` with no value shows the unseen-changes dot; a number shows a count. Use `separator` between the side pane entries and the panel entries (Terminal).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Codicon name, e.g. diff-multiple, files, globe, terminal

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name and hover, with the keybinding, e.g. 'Files (⇧⌘E)'

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: The side pane shows this entry's tab (aria-pressed)

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: Present: show the badge. Empty = dot; a number = count badge

attributes.name: separator
attributes.description: Render the group separator instead of an entry

examples.title: Entries
